subject: Veritak eval onramp — commitments, usage limits, and close cadence
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@veritak.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Veritak Evaluation Team <eval-team@veritak.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval artifacts and timeline — quick alignment

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Veritak is excited to begin a short evaluation. We wanted to confirm the plan and constraints before we hand over assets:

- What we plan to share: a 12k-row promptpack (customer support dialogues) and a 300-case testcase CSV for automated scoring.
- Our ask: short-term ephemeral access (30 days), usage limited to inference-only (no re-distribution or training), and export logs for audit.
- Desired close cadence: evaluation completed and feedback call by Oct 15; potential procurement decision by Oct 31.

Could you confirm Redwood's standard MAP content for this type of exchange (ownership, retention, audit log access, and acceptance criteria)? Also happy to upload the prompt pack if there's a secure transfer link.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Head of Applied ML
Veritak Systems

(Attachment: veritak_promptpack_v1.zip )

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@veritak.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts and timeline — quick alignment

Samantha —

Appreciate the clear outline. High level confirmation from Redwood:

1) MAP & custody: we can sign a one-page MAP that captures asset custody (Veritak retains IP, Redwood granted ephemeral inference-only access), acceptance gate (sample pass rate + review call), and destruction timeline (30 days after handover unless extended by mutual consent).

2) Access & audit: we'll provide a secure S3 transfer link for the promptpack and a signed access token for Redwood Private inference staging. We will retain audit logs (who/when/which prompts) for 90 days and can export a CSV on request for your security team.

3) Usage constraints: no training/fine-tuning, no external redistribution, hashed-only storage for logs in staging, limited to 3 concurrent test runners to respect throughput constraints.

4) Acceptance criteria: run the 300 testcase CSV through Redwood's test harness; we return a scoring report and agreed sample of failure cases. If pass rate >= 88% we schedule the feedback call and move to procurement runway.

I'll attach a draft MAP (MAP_draft_VERT-8421.xlsx) and testcase sample list for your review. Monica — can you pick this up for the secure transfer and add retention/export steps? Karthik — flag anything ops/security will need to preapprove.

Next steps: Samantha, if you confirm the constraints we'll share the S3 link today and target a kickoff run tomorrow.

Best,
Priyom Das
Head of Partner Solutions — Redwood Inference
(Attachment: MAP_draft_VERT-8421.xlsx )

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Veritak MAP/transfer checklist

Quick internal note — actions I'm taking:
- I'll create a time-limited S3 presigned URL (48h) and upload transfer checks to the shared drive.
- Configure staging inference token with scope: inference-only, 30-day expiry, and audit-log export enabled.
- Confirm with Security (Naomi) that hashed logs meet Veritak's audit needs; if they request raw logs we'll need a signed NDA addendum.

Karthik: can you pre-provision the 3 concurrent test runners and lock TTLs on KV cache to avoid inadvertent caching of prompts?

I'll follow up when the link is ready.

—Monica

From: Samantha Liu <samantha@veritak.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Veritak Evaluation Team <eval-team@veritak.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts and timeline — quick alignment

Thanks all — that works. Two clarifications before we proceed:

1) Can Redwood include a short clause in the MAP that requires explicit destruction confirmation (signed email) from Redwood at takedown? Our compliance team wants an auditable confirmation.
2) If we hit blockers in-staging (false positives due to tokenization differences), who should we loop in at Redwood to triage within 24 hours?

If you can answer these, we'll upload veritak_promptpack_v1.zip to the link when it's live.

Samantha

On Tue, 30 Sep 2025 at 11:03, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Samantha —
>
> Appreciate the clear outline. High level confirmation from Redwood:
>
> 1) MAP & custody: we can sign a one-page MAP that captures asset custody...

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@veritak.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Oct 2025 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts and timeline — quick alignment

Samantha —

Short answers: yes & who.

1) Destruction confirmation: agreed. We'll add a one-line clause in the MAP that Redwood will send a signed email confirmation and a SHA256 checksum of the deleted bundle within 48 hours of takedown. That provides an auditable proof for your compliance team.

2) Triage contact: primary is Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.com) — she will own day-to-day triage; escalation to Naomi Feldman (security) or Karthik Iyer (runtime/ops) if the issue requires a patch or infra change. We commit to an initial response within 24 hours during the evaluation window.

We will: provision the S3 link today (48h window), send the MAP draft for signature, and spin up the 3 test runners tomorrow morning PST. If you upload today we can run a kickoff harness the same day and aim to ship the scoring report within 48 hours of the first run.

Looking forward to it — will share links shortly.

Best,
Priyom
